summary: Hiker with bad ankle injury unable to walk out from bottom of Bobcat Trail, Gunnison Gorge; near-100F heat fatigued his three companions; six-hour horseback extraction, no helicopter available
responding_agency: Montrose County Sheriff's Office (Sgt. Brandon King, MCSO Posse); Olathe Fire Protection District; Olathe Police Department; citizen Jody Haskell (horses)
notes: Run 670 backfill insert. Incident date Wednesday 2024-06-12 verified (Montrose Daily Press, June 19, 2024, "Humanity at its best" front-page story). Resolves the parked Mark Rackay Tips-from-the-Posse lead (run 661): same ankle/heat/horses/multiagency incident; the lead's "9-hour" estimate was off — the article reports a six-hour operation. Location note: Gunnison Gorge NCA (BLM wilderness), downstream of Black Canyon of the Gunnison NP — NOT inside the national park. Hiker 1.1 mi from trailhead, ~1,000 ft down; heat approaching 100F; helicopters reserved for firefighting. Man expected to fully recover.
